title: Bill
tagline: Bill is an agent embedded into a Farcaster framework, designed to consistently deliver an 8% APR on stablecoins.
description:
1. Any Farcaster user can interact with Bill via frame. 
2. After depositing any Ethereum token, Bill will transform into stables and to delivers an 8% APR.
3. Every time a new user interacts, Bill will ease a separated wallet fully controlled by the user.
4. Bill provides a dashboard to follow your position status, add funds or withdrawal.
how_its_made:
Under the friendly and easy to use farcaster frames is where Bill works, an agent that get 8% APR rewards under a predefine risks criteria.  

BIll uses 

**Agent**

- [Optimus Agent Autonolas](https://olas.network/agent-economies/optimus)

**Front End**

- Farcaster frames

**Wallet**

- **Base wallet**

**Payments**

- Paycaster to receive and send funds to users wallet.

**Analytics Source**

- Blockscout

**Swaps**

- CowSwap ****(swaps and pricing) Programmatic orders

**Protocols**

- Base
- Ethereum
- Optimism
